 November 20, 2026 7:34 AM 
 Lakshya, Kidambi and Rakshitha play their quarterfinal matches at Hong Kong Open Super 500 tournament today
 In badminton, Indian shuttlers Lakshya Sen, Kidambi Srikanth and Rakshitha Ramraj will play their respective quarterfinal matches at the Hong Kong Open Super 500 tournament today. In men’s singles, Lakshya Sen entered the quarterfinals after defeating Denmark’s Rasmus Gemke 21-11, 21-18. He will next face Singapore’s Loh Kean Yew, while Kidambi Srikanth will take on Thailand’s Kunlavut Vitidsarn this morning.
 In women’s singles, Rakshitha Ramraj advanced to the quarterfinals after stunning China’s Tokyo Olympic champion Chen Yu Fei 21-18, 24-22. She will next meet Thailand’s Pornpawee Chochuwong. In men’s doubles, the Indian pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty also reached the quarterfinals with a straight-game victory over Malaysia’s Nur Mohd Azriyn Ayub and Tan Wee Kiong, 21-19, 21-16. Indian duo will next face China’s Hu Ke Yuan and Lin Xiang Yi today to secure a place in the semifinals.
